mission.objective: Implement only a pure authenticated encryption helper and its synthetic tests for the current custody mission. Do not execute neural extraction or claim OS isolation.

requirements: Use cryptography AESGCM AES256 random32byte key and12byte nonce
Encrypt fixed-size uncompressed bytes with authenticated context encoded canonical JSON
Output ciphertext envelope only, never plaintext hashes or keys
Validate framing, key/nonce lengths, context; wrong key/tamper/context fail closed
Pure functions only; no file/network/subprocess/rawdata access
Tests use synthetic fixed-size integer payloads,verify equal ciphertext length under final canary changes,wrongkey,tamper and AAD rejection
Use existing Hermes Python for tests if available
Edit only cipher_core.py and test_cipher_core.py; do not change registration/protocol/other code
constraints: No actual or printed keys; no stdout plaintext/final canaries
No Git/ops edits or oldevidence modifications
No scientific findings/security gate PASS from unit tests
